messages:
maya: Heads up — I put together a quick idea: orchestrated apply for flags to reduce overlapping writes. global mutex + pre-apply snapshot + post-apply snapshot + heatmap telemetry to spot thrash. WIP, want feedback.

jordan: what do you mean by global mutex? a single DB row? redis lock? worried about latency impact on large rollouts

maya: Redis lock per-config-name, TTL 30s, and fallback to queue. For big rollouts we do chunked apply (cohorts) with local coordinator. TTL tuned to max expected apply time. :thinking: 

liam: We already have etcd-based leases for snapshots in other flows — can we reuse? Also need idempotency token on apply: if operator retries, don't double-count telemetry.

anya: heatmap idea: capture cohort, apply-start, apply-end, success/failure, pre/post diff size. feed to console as a 2D heatmap: time x cohort with saturation for failures. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

sam: what about deadlock / lost locks? @ops-bot should auto-unjack if lock held > TTL with evidence. Also add 'dry-run' apply mode that produces planned diffs and estimated time.

ops-bot: ops-bot: detected long lock for config 'route-weights' earlier today. Auto-release scheduled after TTL but flagged for manual review. See /ops/locks/1930000001

jordan: concern: how to surface per-tenant backpressure? chunking will slow tenants unequally. Need quotas per-tenant and per-operator.

maya: Agree — plan: coordinator enforces per-tenant rate limits and global concurrency cap. Console panel shows live progress + per-tenant ETA + a 'pause' button. :pause_button: 

liam: Implementation nit: use compare-and-swap on config version for atomicity instead of relying only on lock.

anya: Telemetry: heatmap + anomaly alert if post-diff > threshold or error rate spikes. Also keep sampled pre/post payloads (redacted) for rollbacks.

sam: OK can we write a short RFC? I'll draft and add a mock console panel in Figma. Who wants to pair on the implementation plan?

maya: I'll draft RFC. @liam can you do CAS sketch? @anya can mock heatmap? @sam can own rollout playbook? Thanks.
